seo_description: Sampler plugin built in C++/JUCE with granular synthesis, custom tremolo DSP, zero-delay filters, and compressor. VST3 and AU.
hero.title: Audio
hero.subtitle: Q
hero.tagline: C++/JUCE Sampler Plugin / VST3 & AU / Granular Synthesis
about.text: A sampler plugin I built in C++/JUCE to solve problems I had making music. Load any audio file, manipulate it in real-time, and automate everything from your DAW.
features.f1.title: Granular Synthesis
features.f1.desc: Chops audio into tiny grains with randomized playback for textures and sound design.
features.f2.title: Custom Tremolo
features.f2.desc: Hand-coded per-sample sine LFO. Rate and depth respond instantly.
features.f3.title: Zero-Delay Filters
features.f3.desc: TPT high-pass and low-pass, full 20Hz-20kHz range, no artifacts.
features.f4.title: Tempo Control
features.f4.desc: Resample from 20-300 BPM with custom loop regions.
features.f5.title: Volume Safety
features.f5.desc: Auto-stops playback when peaks exceed safe levels.
features.f6.title: DAW Automation
features.f6.desc: Every parameter automatable via APVTS. Session state saved and restored.
